purpose: Teach: ヨット/カビ/就寝/ポッドキャスト/セルフ/時差/三位一体/皇太子

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ヨット部に憧れてたな
lines.en: Riku, you always wanted to join the yacht club, didn't you?
lines.style: Bright, teasing accusation. Leans forward slightly. The rhythm of someone catching a friend in something they've noticed. Warm but playfully relentless.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お風呂のカビ取りバイトしたな、桜
lines.en: Oh, so you did that gross bathroom mold-removal job, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry counterattack, barely a smile in the voice. Turns it back on her without heat. The timing of someone who's been waiting to use this. Light and pointed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、就寝時間遅いだろ
lines.en: You're a night owl, aren't you? Always up late.
lines.style: Observant, gentle push. Not accusing—noticing. The tone of someone who's watched this pattern and finally mentioning it. Curious, not judgmental.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、毎日ポッドキャスト聴いてるな、桜
lines.en: And you listen to podcasts every single day, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. Matter-of-fact, like he's putting another puzzle piece down. Not trying to trap her—just stating what he's seen. Steady.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、セルフレジ得意だな
lines.en: You're really good with self-checkouts, aren't you?
lines.style: Admiring almost, but quick—like he doesn't want to make a thing of it. The voice of someone noticing something small that matters. Brief, genuine.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、海外旅行の時差つらかったろ?桜
lines.en: Didn't the time difference kill you when you were traveling overseas, Sakura?
lines.style: Sympathetic smirk. Leans back like he's enjoying the memory of her suffering slightly. Warmth underneath—not mean, just amused. The timing of someone delivering a gentle jab.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、世界史で三位一体習ったろ?
lines.en: You studied the Trinity in world history, right?
lines.style: Light, curious lob. Testing whether she was paying attention in that class. The rhythm of a question more than an accusation. Genuine interest mixed with mild teasing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ニュースで皇太子殿下の話題チェックしてたな、桜
lines.en: You were checking the news when that crown prince story broke, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Closer now, quieter. The observation of someone who noticed her noticing. Not accusatory—intimate almost. Like he's naming something he's seen her care about. Gentle.
